reading: Comedian Katherine Ryan said she felt “grief and relief” after Russell Brand was convicted of rape and sexual assault.
On Thursday, the court found Brand guilty of one charge of rape and three charges of sexual assault.
He was acquitted of three other charges, including two rape charges.
On her podcast, Ryan said the verdict had left her emotional and that she had great respect for the survivors.
She said they came forward even though Brand was famous and powerful and had fans ready to attack them.
Ryan said that whatever the outcome in court, the people who had been hurt would continue to feel the effects.
In an earlier TV interview, Ryan described someone in the entertainment industry as a “predator”, a person who harms others by taking advantage of them.
In 2022, Ryan said she could not name the man because she believed doing so could cause legal problems.
There were widespread rumours that Ryan meant Brand, but she has not confirmed that she was talking about him.
Police said they were also investigating further rape allegations from two women.

vocabulary.definition: Formal claims in a criminal case that someone broke the law.
Was found not guilty of a particular crime in court.
Chose to speak up and tell others about harm they had experienced themselves.
The decision in a trial about whether someone is guilty.
The businesses that make shows, films, music and other entertainment.
Heard or discussed by many people.
Stated clearly that something people believed or reported was true.
Claims that someone did something wrong; the claims alone do not prove what happened.

entries.ja: 刑事事件で、ある人が法律を破ったとする正式な申し立て。
entries.ko: 형사 사건에서 어떤 사람이 법을 어겼다는 공식적인 주장.
entries.zh-Hans: 刑事案件中关于某人违反法律的正式指控。
entries.es: Acusaciones formales en un proceso penal en las que se afirma que alguien infringió la ley.
entries.pt-BR: Acusações formais feitas em um processo criminal, segundo as quais alguém violou a lei.
entries.fr: Accusations formulées officiellement dans une affaire pénale, selon lesquelles une personne a enfreint la loi.
entries.de: In einem Strafverfahren offiziell erhobene Vorwürfe, jemand habe gegen das Gesetz verstoßen.

entries.ja: 特定の犯罪について、裁判で無罪とされた。
entries.ko: 특정 범죄에 대해 법원에서 무죄 판결을 받았다.
entries.zh-Hans: 经法院审理，就某项具体罪名被判无罪。
entries.es: Un tribunal determinó que no era culpable de un delito concreto.
entries.pt-BR: Um tribunal decidiu que a pessoa não era culpada de um crime específico.
entries.fr: A été déclaré non coupable d’une infraction précise par un tribunal.
entries.de: Wurde vor Gericht in Bezug auf eine bestimmte Straftat für nicht schuldig befunden.

entries.ja: 自分が受けた被害について声を上げ、ほかの人に話すことを選んだ。
entries.ko: 자신이 직접 겪은 피해에 대해 나서서 다른 사람들에게 이야기하기로 했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 决定站出来，向别人讲述自己曾经受到的伤害。
entries.es: Decidieron hablar abiertamente y contarles a otras personas lo que habían sufrido personalmente.
entries.pt-BR: Decidiram se manifestar e contar a outras pessoas o que elas mesmas haviam sofrido.
entries.fr: Ont choisi de prendre la parole et de raconter à d’autres ce qu’ils avaient eux-mêmes subi.
entries.de: Entschieden sich, offen darüber zu sprechen und anderen zu erzählen, was sie selbst erlitten hatten.

entries.ja: ある人が有罪かどうかについて、裁判で下される判断。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람이 유죄인지에 대해 재판에서 내리는 판단.
entries.zh-Hans: 审判中对某人是否有罪作出的裁决。
entries.es: Decisión que se toma en un juicio sobre si una persona es culpable.
entries.pt-BR: Decisão tomada em um julgamento sobre se uma pessoa é culpada.
entries.fr: Décision rendue lors d’un procès sur la culpabilité d’une personne.
entries.de: Die Entscheidung in einem Gerichtsverfahren darüber, ob jemand schuldig ist.

entries.ja: 番組や公演、映画、音楽などの娯楽を作る企業の集まり。
entries.ko: 공연, 방송 프로그램, 영화, 음악 등 즐길 거리를 만드는 기업들.
entries.zh-Hans: 制作节目、电影、音乐及其他娱乐内容的企业。
entries.es: Conjunto de empresas que producen programas, espectáculos, películas, música y otras formas de entretenimiento.
entries.pt-BR: Conjunto de empresas que produzem programas, espetáculos, filmes, música e outras formas de entretenimento.
entries.fr: Ensemble des entreprises qui produisent des émissions, des spectacles, des films, de la musique et d’autres formes de divertissement.
entries.de: Die Unternehmen, die Shows, Filme, Musik und andere Unterhaltungsangebote produzieren.

entries.ja: 多くの人が耳にしたり、話題にしたりしている。
entries.ko: 많은 사람이 들어 봤거나 그에 대해 이야기한.
entries.zh-Hans: 许多人听说过或谈论过的。
entries.es: Que muchas personas han oído mencionar o han comentado.
entries.pt-BR: Que muitas pessoas ouviram mencionar ou comentaram.
entries.fr: Dont beaucoup de personnes ont entendu parler ou discuté.
entries.de: Von vielen Menschen gehört oder besprochen.

entries.ja: 人々が信じていたことや伝えていたことが事実だとはっきり述べた。
entries.ko: 사람들이 믿었거나 전한 내용이 사실이라고 분명히 밝혔다.
entries.zh-Hans: 明确表示，人们所相信或讲述的某件事是真的。
entries.es: Afirmó con claridad que era cierto algo que la gente creía o había contado.
entries.pt-BR: Afirmou claramente que algo em que as pessoas acreditavam ou que haviam relatado era verdade.
entries.fr: A déclaré clairement que ce que des personnes croyaient ou avaient rapporté était vrai.
entries.de: Erklärte klar, dass etwas, das Menschen glaubten oder berichtet hatten, wahr war.

entries.ja: ある人が悪いことをしたという主張。その主張だけでは、何が起きたかは証明できない。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람이 잘못된 일을 했다는 주장. 그런 주장만으로는 무슨 일이 있었는지 입증할 수 없다.
entries.zh-Hans: 指称某人做了错事的说法。仅凭这些说法无法证明发生了什么。
entries.es: Afirmaciones de que alguien hizo algo indebido. Por sí solas, esas afirmaciones no prueban lo que ocurrió.
entries.pt-BR: Afirmações de que alguém fez algo errado. Essas afirmações, por si sós, não provam o que aconteceu.
entries.fr: Affirmations selon lesquelles une personne a fait quelque chose de mal. À elles seules, ces affirmations ne prouvent pas ce qui s’est passé.
entries.de: Behauptungen, dass jemand etwas Falsches getan hat. Die Behauptungen allein beweisen nicht, was passiert ist.
